subject: DeltaForge renewal — staged ramp with tethered credit and limited price anchoring
messages:
From: Oliver Chan <oliver.chan@deltaforge.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@deltaforge.io>
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal pricing request — ask for price anchoring and elasticity on capacity

Hi Laura,

We're preparing for our fiscal Q3 planning and want to lock in an economic runway for the next 12 months. DeltaForge is very happy with Redwood's latency gains, but the team needs: 

- A 12-month renewal with a limited price anchor (6 months locked at current blended rate) because we have customer commitments for our product launches.
- A staged capacity ramp from 5k GPU-hours/month to 12k over four quarters.
- A protective credit pool if we have unexpected spikes (>25% over committed usage) to avoid immediate overage shocks.

Can you propose a structure that keeps us protected while giving Redwood confidence on committed economics? We are open to a modest increase in committed units in exchange for credits or a short-term price anchor.

Best,
Oliver
Oliver Chan
Head of Infrastructure
DeltaForge

[Attachment: forecast_q3_q4.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Chan <oliver.chan@deltaforge.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal pricing request — ask for price anchoring and elasticity on capacity

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear ask and the forecast doc.

Quick summary of what we can offer immediately and what we need to confirm with finance/ops: 

1) Price anchor: 6-month price hold at your current blended rate for the first six months after renewal effective date. After that, rate reverts to the agreed long-term committed slab unless usage materially exceeds committed velocity.

2) Staged ramp + commit: Convert your current paygo + small retainer into a 12-month committed profile with quarterly ramp steps: 5k -> 7k -> 9k -> 12k GPU-hours. Commit guarantees apply starting month 1 for the quoted retainer baseline, with true-up on quarterly cadence.

3) Spike protection credit pool: We'll provision a $XXk credit pool (applies to token/GPU-hour overages up to 25% per quarter). Spikes beyond that will use the overage price but we can tier a softer overage step for the following quarter to smooth billing.

4) Operational guardrails: prefix caching, batch sizing guidance, and a burst lane for scheduled launch windows. We'll include recommended autoscaling policies.

I have attached a draft quote and a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestone dates. Monica, Markus — can you confirm credit sizing and whether we can stage a conditional 6-month anchor that requires a minimum aggregate commit of 36k GPU-hours for the 12 months? If procurement accepts the staged ramp, we can fast-track signatures and reserve the burst pool for their launch windows.

Oliver — if that structure seems directionally correct I’ll follow up with a refreshed PDF quote and a redlined MAP for signature.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_quote_DF-44-v2.pdf]
[Attachment: DeltaForge_MAP_v3.xlsx]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal pricing request — ask for price anchoring and elasticity on capacity

Laura — quick internal ops/finance notes: 

- Credit pool: finance is willing to commit a $45,000 credit pool capped per quarter for spikes up to 25% of committed GPU-hours. We should phrase as a "smoothing credit" that applies automatically to the first 25% of overage per quarter.
- Anchor conditions: 6-month price anchor ok only if DeltaForge signs to the 12-month commit with a minimum aggregate 36k GPU-hour baseline (your proposed ramp qualifies). We cannot extend anchor beyond 6 months without executive approval.
- Early exit: propose a 60-day pro-rated unwind fee if they terminate early in first 6 months (protects the anchor exposure).

Also recommend adding a "launch reserve" of 1k GPU-hours per launch window (two windows allowed) at reserved burst rate; this keeps on-call ops predictable.

Markus — confirm margin impact on the ramped commit (I used conservative unit cost). Ben — sales discount corridor? We should keep discount to <=12% blended to protect net ARR.

Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal pricing request — ask for price anchoring and elasticity on capacity

Agree with Monica. Two operational clarifications: 

- The smoothing credit should be applied as an invoice-level credit bucket (easy for billing) and we need an SLA clause that qualifies eligible spikes (system-level incidents excluded).
- Burst reserve: acceptable but only if we also require a 72-hour launch notice to avoid sudden capacity re-allocation; otherwise we risk impacting other commitments.

I've updated the quote (redwood_quote_DF-44-v3.pdf) with the blended tier economics and the 12% max discount corridor. Attached notes include the margin delta summary. If procurement pushes for more than a 6-month anchor, we escalate to VP for approval.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Commercial Finance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_quote_DF-44-v3.pdf]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Chan <oliver.chan@deltaforge.io>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@deltaforge.io>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Jun 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal pricing request — final draft MAP + quote (action required)

Oliver — attaching the final MAP and the updated quote per our internal approvals. Highlights: 

- 12-month commitment: quarterly ramp 5k / 7k / 9k / 12k GPU-hours. Aggregate minimum 36k GPU-hours.
- 6-month price anchor at current blended rate (conditional on signature of MAP and deposit equivalent to 10% of first-quarter invoice).
- $45,000 quarterly smoothing credit bucket that applies to first 25% overage per quarter (applied as invoice credit).
- Two launch-reserve windows (1,000 GPU-hours each) available with 72-hour notice.
- Early termination: pro-rated unwind fee within first 60 days to cover anchor exposure.

Next steps: 
1) If agreeable, countersign the MAP and return (DeltaForge legal) — we’ll send DocuSign.
2) Provide launch windows and any necessary SSO/KMS manifest for private endpoints.

I’ve attached: redwood_quote_DF-44-v3.pdf, DeltaForge_MAP_v4.xlsx, SOC2-summary.pdf.

Looking forward — let me know if you want a quick call tomorrow to walk the MAP.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_quote_DF-44-v3.pdf]
[Attachment: DeltaForge_MAP_v4.xlsx]
[Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf]
